name: Muga de Sayago (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and blue, the blue charged with a white fleur-de-lis.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag of the municipality of Muga de Sayago were approved by resolution of 23 December 1998 of the Diputación of Zamora; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes, white next to the hoist and blue with a white fleur-de-lis at the fly.
